description: Evals cho QD10 Cross-Module Integration Lane — kiem tra PRE-GATE skip conditions, probe signal emission cho cross-module drifts, API contract violations, event handler gaps, va orphan references.

test_cases.name: PRE-GATE SKIP khi cross_module_dependencies rong

input.scenario: wf-fix-integration duoc spawn nhung req-registry.json khong co cross_module_dependencies hoac mang rong.

expected.behavior: SKIP lane — ghi lane-status.json voi status=skipped va error_code=E100

test_cases.validation: Lane phai SKIP ngay tai Step 8 PRE-GATE. Khong chay bat ky probe nao. lane-status.json phai co status='skipped' va error_code='E100'. Orchestrator nhan skipped va tiep tuc.

test_cases.name: PRE-GATE SKIP khi profile=quick

input.scenario: wf-fix-integration spawn voi profile=quick. cross_module_dependencies co 3 pairs.

expected.behavior: SKIP lane — lane-status.json status=skipped, skip_reason chua 'profile=quick'

test_cases.validation: Lane phai SKIP tai Step 10 PRE-GATE khi profile=quick. Nhanh hon quick profile = no cross-module analysis. Orchestrator nhan skipped va tiep tuc.

test_cases.name: P-QD10-cross-module-ref-static phat hien deprecated import

input.scenario: Registry co pair CRM->QUOTATION, entity Customer. Provider export 'CustomerDto' da bi deprecated va thay bang 'CustomerProfileDto'. Consumer code (quotation module) van import 'CustomerDto' cu.

test_cases.validation: Probe dung Serena find_referencing_symbols(CustomerDto) hoac GitNexus impact(CustomerDto) de phat hien consumer dang import deprecated export. Signal MEDIUM voi evidence la import path. POST-GATE T3.5 enforce evidence co mat.

test_cases.name: P-QD10-api-contract-drift phat hien breaking change (field rename)

input.scenario: Provider OpenAPI spec declare field 'customer_name' (string, required). Consumer TypeScript interface dang dung 'customerName' (camelCase) — field rename tao ra breaking change khi goi API.

test_cases.validation: Probe dung Serena find_symbol(provider_dto) + parse consumer DTO de phat hien field name mismatch. Signal HIGH 'api_contract_breaking_change' voi schema_diff evidence. POST-GATE T3.7 enforce schema evidence co mat.

test_cases.name: P-QD10-event-handler-coverage phat hien missing handler

input.scenario: Registry cross_module_dependency khai bao consumer QUOTATION subscribe event 'customer.profile_updated'. Code trong QUOTATION module khong co bat ky handler nao cho event nay.

test_cases.validation: Probe dung GitNexus query('event:customer.profile_updated') hoac Grep on('customer.profile_updated') de kiem tra handler. Khong tim thay → emit signal HIGH 'event_handler_missing'. Consumer module QUOTATION khong co handler cho declared event.

test_cases.name: P-QD10-orphan-reference-runtime phat hien orphan FK reference

input.scenario: Registry pair QUOTATION->CRM, binding_type=foreign_key, entity Customer. DB co row trong quotation table co customer_id=999 nhung khong co Customer row voi id=999 (orphan reference).

test_cases.validation: Probe phai verify env != production truoc khi query (safety guard E104). Query dung LEFT JOIN ... WHERE provider.id IS NULL. Phat hien orphan → emit signal CRITICAL voi query_result evidence. POST-GATE T3.6 enforce query evidence. POST-GATE T3.8 enforce severity=critical.

test_cases.name: P-QD10-orphan-reference-runtime BLOCK khi env=production

input.scenario: wf-fix-integration duoc spawn trong environment production (DB_ENV=production hoac DATABASE_URL contains 'prod').

expected.behavior: P-QD10-orphan-reference-runtime phai STOP voi E104 — khong query production DB

test_cases.validation: Safety guard phai detect env=production va STOP probe truoc khi connect DB. Ghi E104 vao probe output. Lane tiep tuc voi cac probes khac (chi orphan-reference-runtime bi skip). Khong duoc query production DB trong bat ky truong hop nao.
